app.title: VaultChecker, store credit for your business

main.catchy: Manage your store's credit without losing a cent
main.highlightedfeature: VaultChecker works out the interest, installments and late fees for you. You record the sale, the app does the math.

problem.section: The paper ledger just can't keep up

problem1.subtitle: Manual math
problem1.description: Working out interest and installments by calculator is slow and error-prone.
problem1.phrase: "How much was it with the overdue days?"

problem2.subtitle: Scattered accounts
problem2.description: Each customer on a different sheet; nothing adds up at month-end.

problem3.subtitle: No late-fee control
problem3.description: You don't know who owes, how much, or since when.
problem3.phrase: "I thought they had already paid me."

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.question1: How does it do the math?
FAQ.answer1: You set the price and the interest you agreed, and VaultChecker figures out the installments and late fees instantly. No formulas, no calculator.
FAQ.question2: Can I set my own interest?
FAQ.answer2: Sure. You set the rate with each customer and the app applies it for you.
FAQ.answer3: Yes, it works it out on its own based on the days overdue.
FAQ.question4: Does it work for any business?
FAQ.answer4: Yes: grocers, greengrocers, butchers, pharmacies and more. It's multi-store.

footer.summary: Store-credit control for your neighborhood business.
